initiatives.name: Mining Software Digital Platform Strategy
initiatives.summary: Weir completed the acquisition of Mining Software Holdings Pty Ltd (Micromine) to accelerate its move into digital and software-based mining solutions, equipping the company with a broad portfolio of equipment-agnostic software solutions across the mining value chain.

evidence.title: Acquisition of Fast2Mine software business
evidence.summary: Weir acquired Fast2Mine, a Brazilian mining software technology company, to further augment its software portfolio and strengthen its digital mining solutions offering alongside Micromine.
evidence.quote: The Group completed the acquisition of Fast2 Mine Tecnologia e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas Ltda ('Fast2Mine') on 11 November 2025, for an enterprise value of Brazilian Real 172m (£25m).

evidence.title: Acquisition of Fast2Mine - Complementary to Micromine
evidence.summary: Weir acquired Fast2Mine on 11 November 2025, which is highly complementary to the Micromine portfolio and will be integrated with Micromine and reported within the ESCO segment. Contains contingent consideration arrangement.
evidence.quote: Fast2Mine was acquired on 11 November 2025 and is highly complementary with the Micromine® portfolio. Fast2Mine will be integrated with Micromine and reported within the ESCO segment.

evidence.title: Building sector-leading digital platform for mining
evidence.summary: Weir is creating a next-generation digital platform leveraging Micromine and other acquisitions, aiming to be the leading software solutions provider to the mining industry and optimize customer performance across the value chain.
evidence.quote: With our suite of next-generation solutions, we are creating a sector-leading digital platform that helps customers optimise their performance at each step along the value chain.

evidence.title: Strategic pivot into digital and software mining solutions
evidence.summary: Through the Micromine and Fast2Mine acquisitions, Weir is significantly accelerating its transformation from a pure engineered hardware provider into a meaningful player in software and digitally-enabled mining solutions.
evidence.quote: These investments position Weir as not only a leading provider of engineered hardware, but a meaningful player in software and digitally-enabled solutions, significantly strengthening our commitment and ability to deliver mining technology for a sustainable future.

evidence.title: Acquisition of Micromine mining software business
evidence.summary: Weir completed the acquisition of Mining Software Holdings Pty Ltd (Micromine) to accelerate its move into digital and software-based mining solutions, equipping the company with a broad portfolio of equipment-agnostic software solutions across the mining value chain.
evidence.quote: The acquisition of Mining Software Holdings Pty Ltd ('Micromine') completed on 30 April 2025 for an enterprise value of Australian Dollar $1.3bn (£624m).

initiatives.name: Climate Transition and Emissions Reduction
initiatives.summary: Weir updated and published its Climate Transition Plan, informed by UK Transition Plan Taskforce recommendations, setting out its approach to align with a net zero world and engaging on SBTi standard reform.

evidence.title: Scope 1 and 2 CO2e Emissions Reduction
evidence.summary: Weir achieved a 31% absolute CO2e reduction versus 2019 baseline, verified and aligned to SBTi targets, exceeding the target of 29% reduction for 2025.
evidence.quote: Reduce scope 1 and 2 C O 2 e vs 2019 base aligned to SBTi. 29% absolute C O 2 e reduction achieved. 31% absolute C O 2 e reduction achieved and verified.

evidence.title: Updated Climate Transition Plan published
evidence.summary: Weir updated and published its Climate Transition Plan, informed by UK Transition Plan Taskforce recommendations, setting out its approach to align with a net zero world and engaging on SBTi standard reform.
evidence.quote: In 2025, we updated our Climate Transition Plan, informed by the recommendations of the UK Transition Plan Taskforce. Our updated report was published in early 2026.

evidence.title: Scope 1&2 emissions reduction exceeding SBTi target
evidence.summary: Weir achieved a 31% reduction in Scope 1&2 greenhouse gas emissions since 2019, exceeding its Science Based Targets initiative-approved target of 30% reduction by 2030, though the baseline will be reviewed following acquisitions.
evidence.quote: Scope 1&2 C O 2 e emissions in 2025 were 126,338 t C O 2 e, a cumulative reduction of 31% since 2019, driven by many projects at our sites across the world. This exceeds our Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi)-approved targeted reduction of 30%.
